coordinator_decision: Criterion A was frozen before r3, FAILED, remains failed and is not re-scored. For the own-camera PF with dead-reckoning between visual fixes, conservative process noise is acceptable and standard for robustness to under-modelled dynamics (Thrun, Burgard and Fox 2005, chapters 4-5, noise inflation). Criterion B is defined now, after seeing r3 but before any new data. All v89 steps and PRBS are training. Only NEW held-out v88 unloaded data on other maps may validate B. An axis without step/PRBS excitation or a frozen candidate remains null.

mean.family: sign-common gain, running tau, stop tau; three parameters per excited axis
mean.law: v_next=v+(1-exp(-dt/tau))*(gain*u-v); displacement=v_next*dt, as in the existing consumer. tau is running while any issued body command is nonzero, otherwise stop. Other-axis mean and cross gains are zero in an axis-only prediction, not fitted cross coupling.
mean.fit: Unweighted least squares of driven-component endpoint errors for all listed horizons, pooling all v89 step+stop and PRBS+stop windows. Positive log parameters, bounds gain [0.05,4], running tau [0.01,4] s, stop tau [0.005,0.5] s; initial [1,0.8,0.06].
mean.initial_state: Velocity starts at zero at recording start and is warmed ONLY by issued commands. Each window has an ideal start-pose fix. Measured velocity, future poses, contacts and simulator state are never predictor inputs.

noise.selection: Choose the smallest coefficients at or above M1 attaining >=0.95 two-sigma training coverage in EVERY axis, split (steps and PRBS separately), horizon and component. There is no unique componentwise least pair when relative and absolute noise trade off. Freeze this tie-break: lexicographically minimize (noise_rel[0],noise_rel[1],noise_rel[2],noise_abs[2],noise_abs[0],noise_abs[1]), sharing the vector across forward/left profiles. Thus keep relative slopes at M1 floors, find the minimum yaw absolute floor, then the minimum forward and left absolute floors. With the zero-yaw mean and axis-only translation these constraints are triangular; each absolute minimum is the maximum, across groups, of the ceil(0.95*n)-th smallest per-window quadratic threshold. Add only 1e-12 numerical slack to an inflated coefficient. This is an exact lexicographic/Pareto minimum under the declared ordering, not a claim that all possible relative/absolute trade-offs have one componentwise minimum.
noise.propagation: Independent per-tick velocity noise contributes diag((sigma_velocity*dt)^2). Propagate pose covariance with first-order heading coupling in the start-pose frame, using the existing Euler consumer mean. No initial pose, scale_std, scale_walk, reset, measurement, roughening or map-prior covariance is credited. This is a linearized process budget, not a full PF posterior test.

windows: Every 0.05 s start with a complete horizon within each signed step plus following coast, or the continuous PRBS plus following coast. Do not bridge these segments. Include onset, zero-command, reversal and stopping windows; do not thin or centre residuals. Gate every map/case/split separately, never pool away a failing group. Overlapping windows are descriptive, not independent samples.

held_out.requirements: Completed NEW acquisition after this freeze on other maps; raw result/bundle/measurement schedule, issued commands and 0.05 s eval_only poses required. Previously inspected v87/v89 data and identical recorded pose bytes are ineligible regardless of renamed paths. v89 is automatically labelled TRAINING_SMOKE, never validation. No refitting in validation. Incomplete or malformed input is an error, not a pass.
held_out.axis_support: Both signed step and signed PRBS commands are required on that axis, and at least one complete window per horizon in each split. A missing split, missing frozen mean or insufficient horizon support gives null for the axis. Missing axes cannot yield an overall pass.

acceptance.p95_definition: Because sigma varies by window, p95(abs(error)/sigma) <= 2 (NumPy linear percentile). Also report p95 absolute error and sigma min/median/max in physical units; comparing two unrelated marginal percentiles is forbidden.
acceptance.overall: false if any validated axis fails; null if no failures but any axis is unvalidated; true only if all axes pass. Training reports always have null validation decisions.

promotion: No MEASURED_SIM promotion or loader/controller modification. A validation report does not mutate the candidate. Loaded, fine, camera availability, full PF behaviour, hardware and robot task success are outside B.
